metadata.title: Aerosafe complete control catalogue
metadata.disclaimer: Aerosafe is an operational assurance aid. The catalogue contains 52 controls in nine named checklist groups. The guided recommender proposes groups for project review, but every recommendation requires project tailoring and authority confirmation. The final record is not an ECSS certificate, compliance decision, qualification approval, or substitute for the designated authority.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P1 + Q80 Annex D + E40 requirements; synthesized. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Define the AI/ML boundary, ODD, decision authority, interfaces, compensating provisions, and criticality rationale.
controls.inputs: Contractual baseline; system architecture; preliminary hazard analysis; ODD; interface and authority concept; compensating provisions.
controls.owner: System Safety with Product Assurance (PA).
controls.evidence: SCAR/criticality record; approved ODD and boundary/interface description; assumptions; assurance plan.
controls.acceptance criterion: The classification, AI failure propagation, authority boundary, interfaces, and compensating provisions are justified and mutually consistent.
controls.links: Hazards; system/software requirements; architecture; SA-01; FR-01.
controls.residuals: Open assumptions, unresolved interfaces, and criticality dependencies are recorded with owners and due gates.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.2.5 and 5.3.4.1; AI evidence inputs adapted. Status: M.
controls.objective: Review requirements and the AI assurance scope at SRR.
controls.inputs: SC-01 baseline; preliminary ML safety requirements; data and V&V strategy; assurance plan; open actions.
controls.owner: Systems Engineering and PA, supported by Safety, ML, and V&V leads.
controls.evidence: SRR data pack and minutes identifying the baselined AI role, scope, requirements, strategies, and actions.
controls.acceptance criterion: The SRR entry/exit criteria in the tailored review plan are met and every open action has an owner and due gate.
controls.residuals: Unclosed SRR actions and assumptions remain explicit and cannot be treated as accepted evidence.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.3.4.2 + AMLAS-P2/P3; synthesized. Status: M when PDR is in the review plan.
controls.objective: Review the data strategy, architecture, model-class rationale, fallback concept, and verification plan.
controls.inputs: Approved SRR baseline; data requirements; coverage model; architecture; model candidates; target constraints; fallback concept.
controls.owner: Systems Engineering with Data/ML, Software, Safety, and V&V owners.
controls.evidence: PDR data pack, decisions, action log, and updated assurance plan.
controls.acceptance criterion: The proposed architecture and data/verification plans address allocated requirements and hazards with identified residual uncertainties.
controls.links: DM-01 to DM-09; ML-01 to ML-04; DP-07; SA-01.
controls.residuals: Architecture trades, data gaps, and fallback limitations are carried into CDR/TRR planning.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.3.4.3 + AMLAS-P4 + HB40 6.4.2; synthesized. Status: M when CDR is in the review plan.
controls.objective: Review the detailed model/software design and freeze the development baseline.
controls.inputs: Approved PDR actions; model selection; training pipeline; software design; interfaces; target constraints; toolchain records.
controls.owner: ML and Software Engineering with CM, Safety, PA, and V&V.
controls.evidence: CDR baseline covering pipeline, interfaces, reproducibility, selected model, target feasibility, and remaining actions.
controls.acceptance criterion: The design is traceable, reproducible, implementable on the target, and sufficiently mature for test-readiness preparation.
controls.links: CM-02; ML-01 to ML-04; SV-01; DP-01 to DP-03.
controls.residuals: Unresolved design or target constraints are entered as controlled actions and reflected in test scope.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.3.5.1 + AMLAS-P5; AI-specific readiness content adapted. Status: M before applicable verification execution.
controls.objective: Establish test readiness for model, software, system, and independent-assessment activities.
controls.inputs: Frozen test object; independent data; procedures; acceptance criteria; tools; environments; anomaly process; IMVV plan.
controls.owner: V&V lead with QA/CM; IMVV lead for the independent scope.
controls.evidence: TRR data pack, readiness checklist, configuration list, approved procedures, criteria, and open-risk disposition.
controls.acceptance criterion: Test objects and environments are identified and controlled; criteria are predeclared; independence and anomaly handling are adequate.
controls.links: MV-01 to MV-07; SV-01; SY-01; IV-03 to IV-05.
controls.residuals: Any readiness exception is formally limited, owned, and either resolved before execution or explicitly accepted by authority.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.3.4.4 (QR); a separate VVR is a project-defined mapping option. Status: M at QR.
controls.objective: Assess qualification/V&V evidence, anomalies, limitations, waivers, and IMVV findings.
controls.inputs: Requirement-level results; coverage analyses; target evidence; NCRs; waivers; residual-risk record; IMVV report.
controls.owner: V&V and PA with Safety, Engineering, and IMVV participation.
controls.evidence: QR or project-defined VVR data pack, pass/fail matrix, finding dispositions, limitations, and recommendation.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every applicable requirement and assurance claim has a controlled result or approved disposition; unresolved blockers are visible.
controls.gate: QR; project-defined VVR only when included in the review plan.
controls.links: MV-01 to SY-01; DP-01 to DP-03; SA-02 to SA-03; IV-05 to IV-06.
controls.residuals: Open findings, unsupported claims, waivers, and operational restrictions remain attached to the release decision.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.3.4.5 and 5.7; AI release content adapted; ORR is project-defined. Status: M at AR.
controls.objective: Accept one controlled release together with its ODD, operating limitations, rollback, and change controls.
controls.inputs: Qualified configuration; release manifest; approved limitations; operating procedures; rollback; maintenance/change plan; residual risk.
controls.owner: Project/customer acceptance authority supported by PA, CM, Operations, Safety, and Engineering.
controls.evidence: AR/ORR record identifying the accepted release, ODD, restrictions, residual risks, waivers, and operating/change conditions.
controls.acceptance criterion: The accepted configuration is uniquely identified and all conditions of use, rollback provisions, and residual-risk decisions are authorised.
controls.links: CM-02 to CM-03; DP-04 to DP-08; SA-03; IV-06.
controls.residuals: Acceptance is limited to the stated configuration and ODD; changes or anomalies reopen affected evidence.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: Q80 6.2.4 + AMLAS-P3; AI artefact scope adapted. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Configuration-control datasets, labels, partitions, and transformations.
controls.inputs: Data specification; source and custody records; transformation pipeline; split rules; access history.
controls.owner: Configuration Management (CM) and QA with the Data owner.
controls.evidence: Immutable identifiers/hashes, lineage, approved baselines, access history, and links to consuming models.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every data artefact used for evidence or release can be uniquely identified, reproduced, and traced to its approved use.
controls.closure authority: Relevant gate authority accepts the baseline.
controls.residuals: Unavailable source records, mutable data, or uncharacterised transformations are recorded as evidence limitations.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: Q80 6.2.4 + AMLAS-P4 to P6; adapted. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Configuration-control code, parameters, weights, tools, converters, monitors, and target binaries.
controls.inputs: Source repositories; training/build scripts; parameters; model weights; toolchain; converter/compiler settings; monitor configuration.
controls.owner: CM and Engineering, with QA oversight.
controls.evidence: Reproducible training/build/release manifest, identifiers and checksums, environment record, and tool confidence rationale where applicable.
controls.acceptance criterion: The reviewed model, software, and target binary can be reconstructed or otherwise shown equivalent from controlled inputs and tools.
controls.residuals: Non-reproducible or supplier-controlled elements are documented with compensating evidence and confidence limits.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: E40 5.10 + Q80 6.2.4; ML change triggers adapted. Status: M for material changes.
controls.objective: Perform change-impact analysis and reopen affected evidence.
controls.inputs: Change request; affected requirements, data, model, software, tools, target, monitoring, findings, and claims.
controls.owner: Change Control Board (CCB) with CM, Engineering, V&V, Safety, and PA.
controls.evidence: Approved impact analysis, regression/re-review scope, updated traceability, and release decision.
controls.acceptance criterion: All affected artefacts and claims are identified; regression and review depth are justified before the changed baseline is accepted.
controls.gate: CCB and any affected lifecycle gate.
controls.residuals: Deferred regression, inherited evidence, and unchanged-item assumptions are explicit and authorised.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: Q80 6.2.6.12 + AMLAS cross-process links; complete AI evidence graph synthesized. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Maintain forward and backward lifecycle traceability.
controls.inputs: Hazards; requirements; data/model/software configurations; tests; results; claims; findings; waivers; release decisions.
controls.owner: PA/QA controls the traceability process; artefact owners maintain links.
controls.evidence: Queries from hazard to decision and from released binary, result, or finding back to source artefacts and claims.
controls.acceptance criterion: Required forward and backward queries are complete, configuration-consistent, and usable for review and change-impact analysis.
controls.links: All checklist items; especially SA-01 to SA-03 and IV-05 to IV-06.
controls.residuals: Broken, ambiguous, or many-to-one links are logged and cannot be hidden by aggregate status.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: scope, review gates, configuration management, and traceability.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P6 + E40 operations; telemetry/resource interpretation introduced. Status: C; N.A. permitted with rationale.
controls.objective: Define feasible runtime traceability and diagnostic logging.
controls.inputs: Safety-monitoring objectives; event model; platform resources; telemetry bandwidth; retention, privacy, and security constraints.
controls.owner: Operations and Software Engineering with Safety and Security.
controls.evidence: Logging/telemetry specification identifying events, configuration IDs, retention, bandwidth, access, and diagnostic purpose.
controls.acceptance criterion: Runtime records are sufficient for the stated safety/diagnostic purpose without violating resource, privacy, or security constraints; otherwise N.A. is approved.
controls.residuals: Unobservable states, sampling gaps, storage limits, and unavailable telemetry are explicit limitations in the safety argument.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3 + HB40 6.4.1; ECSS gate allocation adapted. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Derive data requirements from the ODD, hazards, and ML safety requirements.
controls.inputs: Approved ODD; hazard analysis; ML safety requirements; intended use; data-source and simulation options.
controls.owner: Data owner and domain expert with Safety/V&V.
controls.evidence: Data specification covering nominal, degraded, boundary, rare, and hazard-relevant strata and the intended role of each partition.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every safety-relevant data need is traceable to a requirement or hazard and has an identified source, coverage rationale, and intended partition use.
controls.residuals: Unavailable strata, simulation dependence, and assumptions about operational representativeness are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3 + HB40 6.4.1 + Q80 6.2.4; synthesized. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Record data provenance and lineage.
controls.inputs: Source systems; sensor/simulator versions; acquisition/generation procedures; transformations; rights and custody information.
controls.owner: Data owner with QA/CM.
controls.evidence: Provenance record with source, version, method, transformations, rights, hashes, custody, and consuming-baseline links.
controls.acceptance criterion: Each sample or dataset can be traced to an authorised source and controlled transformation history sufficient for reproduction and audit.
controls.residuals: Missing provenance, third-party restrictions, or uncertain simulator/sensor pedigree are explicit limitations.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3 + HB40 6.4.1; acceptance fields adapted. Status: M when labelled or measured data are used.
controls.objective: Control labels, ground truth, and measurement uncertainty.
controls.inputs: Labelling protocol; annotator/domain authority; measurement process; calibration; disagreement and error data.
controls.owner: Domain/measurement owner with V&V and QA.
controls.evidence: Label/ground-truth record, disagreement/error estimates, measurement uncertainty, adjudication, and unresolved limitations.
controls.acceptance criterion: Label authority and uncertainty are defined; error/disagreement is quantified or bounded; unresolved ambiguity is reflected in requirements and results.
controls.residuals: Ambiguous labels, proxy ground truth, calibration limits, and unresolved disagreement remain visible.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3/P4 + HB40 6.4.1 to 6.4.2; inherited and operationalized. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Demonstrate partition independence and detect leakage or duplicates.
controls.inputs: Dataset entity/time/source structure; split-generation procedure; duplicate and dependence criteria; access history.
controls.owner: ML and V&V owners with QA.
controls.evidence: Split record, entity/time/source separation checks, duplicate/dependence analysis, leakage findings, and corrective action.
controls.acceptance criterion: Acceptance data are independent of tuning to the justified degree; duplicates and dependencies are removed, controlled, or explicitly accounted for.
controls.residuals: Residual dependence, repeated entities, temporal leakage risk, and unavoidable overlap are quantified and carried into uncertainty.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3 + HB40 6.4.1; residual-gap register adapted. Status: M all; depth is risk-based.
controls.objective: Justify ODD and hazard coverage and record residual gaps.
controls.inputs: ODD model; hazard scenarios; data requirements; scenario catalogue; sample support; simulation credibility evidence.
controls.owner: Data/domain owner with Safety and V&V.
controls.evidence: Coverage matrix by scenario/stratum, sample support, simulation credibility, uncertainty, unsupported regions, and proposed restrictions.
controls.acceptance criterion: Coverage is justified for each claimed use and safety-relevant stratum; unsupported regions are linked to restrictions, fallback, or additional evidence.
controls.residuals: Residual ODD gaps, sparse strata, extrapolation, and simulator limitations are explicitly retained.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3 + HB40 6.4.1; inherited. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Validate data quality and preprocessing.
controls.inputs: Raw and processed baselines; integrity/range rules; missingness policy; preprocessing code; mismatch and sensitivity plan.
controls.owner: Data owner with QA and V&V.
controls.evidence: Integrity, missingness, range, mismatch, preprocessing-sensitivity, and reproducibility results against predeclared thresholds.
controls.acceptance criterion: Data defects and preprocessing effects remain within approved thresholds or have controlled corrective action and impact assessment.
controls.residuals: Known corruption, missingness mechanisms, distribution mismatch, and preprocessing instability are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: Applicable security baseline + Q80 CM principles; poisoning/provenance application adapted. Status: M for assurance-relevant integrity; depth is threat-based.
controls.objective: Protect data and tool integrity.
controls.inputs: Threat model; access model; approved sources; supply-chain information; incident process; integrity mechanisms.
controls.owner: Security owner with PA, QA, and CM.
controls.evidence: Access-control records, integrity verification, approved-source list, tamper evidence, supply-chain checks, and incident handling.
controls.acceptance criterion: Controls address credible modification, poisoning, provenance, access, and supply-chain threats to the depth required by the applicable baseline.
controls.gate: PDR, CDR, and TRR as allocated.
controls.residuals: Unverified suppliers, unavailable signing, residual insider risk, and threat-model exclusions are documented.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: Applicable legal/contractual privacy obligations; explicit N.A. logic introduced. Status: C.
controls.objective: Assess whether privacy obligations apply and implement or justify the resulting controls.
controls.inputs: Data classification; personal/sensitive-data assessment; legal and contractual baseline; intended use; retention and access needs.
controls.owner: Data-protection/project authority with Data owner and Security.
controls.evidence: Applicability decision and, when applicable, lawful/contractual basis, minimisation, access, retention, and protection records.
controls.acceptance criterion: Applicable obligations are satisfied; otherwise a named authority approves a reasoned N.A. decision showing that relevant data are not processed.
controls.residuals: Re-identification, secondary-use, retention, jurisdiction, and third-party transfer limitations are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS data adequacy + application risk analysis; aerospace interpretation adapted. Status: C.
controls.objective: Assess application-relevant bias and fairness.
controls.inputs: Hazards; affected stakeholders; sensor, environment, mission, equipment, geographic, and fault strata; protected attributes when relevant.
controls.owner: Safety/domain authority with Data and V&V owners.
controls.evidence: Performance and uncertainty by relevant strata, disparity rationale, mitigation, and approved N.A. decision when the concept is inapplicable.
controls.acceptance criterion: Safety-relevant disparities are assessed and controlled; demographic fairness is required only when people or protected attributes are relevant.
controls.gate: PDR, TRR, and QR as allocated.
controls.residuals: Small strata, confounding, unavailable attributes, and unresolved disparity are retained as limitations.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P4 + HB40 6.4.2 + Q80 CM; synthesized. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Make model training reproducible.
controls.inputs: Approved data IDs; preprocessing; code; seeds; hyperparameters; libraries; hardware; training procedure.
controls.owner: ML owner with CM.
controls.evidence: Training manifest, logs, environment, parameters, data/model identifiers, and resulting weights.
controls.acceptance criterion: The selected training run can be reproduced or shown equivalent from controlled inputs, with all stochastic and platform factors recorded.
controls.residuals: Non-deterministic variation, unavailable hardware, external services, and irreproducible supplier elements are bounded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P4 + HB40 6.4.2; target-selection fields adapted. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Compare candidates and justify model selection, including target feasibility.
controls.inputs: Predeclared metrics; candidate models; uncertainty method; resource estimates; interpretability and deployment constraints.
controls.owner: ML lead with Software, Safety, and V&V participation.
controls.evidence: Candidate-comparison and selection record covering metrics, uncertainty, complexity, resource feasibility, and residual limitations.
controls.acceptance criterion: The selected model satisfies the declared selection rule and target constraints without concealing failed safety-relevant criteria.
controls.residuals: Near-ties, metric trade-offs, model-class limitations, and target-feasibility uncertainty are explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P4 + HB40 6.4.2; inherited. Status: M where meaningful.
controls.objective: Analyse overfitting, mismatch, and development-time drift.
controls.inputs: Learning curves; partition records; development/operational distributions; calibration and sensitivity plan.
controls.owner: ML and V&V owners.
controls.evidence: Learning curves, sensitivity and mismatch tests, leakage checks, calibration/uncertainty evidence, and corrective actions.
controls.acceptance criterion: No unaddressed overfitting, leakage, or mismatch invalidates the intended-use claims; detected issues have controlled resolution or limitation.
controls.residuals: Residual mismatch, unstable calibration, limited sample support, and unmodelled drift mechanisms are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: data assurance and model learning.
controls.source/status: AMLAS assurance rationale + HB40 model guidance; conditional allocation adapted. Status: C; N.A. requires alternative evidence.
controls.objective: Provide explainability evidence when it supports a requirement or review decision.
controls.inputs: Explanation objective; user and decision; model type; safety claim; candidate methods; validity and stability considerations.
controls.owner: ML owner with Safety, Human Factors/domain, and V&V as relevant.
controls.evidence: Explanation method, suitability and stability assessment, limitations, affected claim, and alternative evidence when N.A.
controls.acceptance criterion: The explanation is fit for the stated assurance/user purpose and does not exceed its validated scope; otherwise alternative evidence is approved.
controls.residuals: Method instability, misleading attribution, user interpretation limits, and non-explainable residuals are explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P2/P5 + E40 5.8; metric/population/uncertainty tuple adapted. Status: M for claimed model properties.
controls.objective: Freeze model-level requirements and acceptance criteria before testing.
controls.inputs: Hazards; ODD; ML safety requirements; evaluated populations/strata; metric and uncertainty methods; test procedure.
controls.owner: Safety and V&V authority with ML/domain input.
controls.evidence: Baselined requirement specifying property, population/ODD, threshold, uncertainty rule, procedure, and decision authority.
controls.acceptance criterion: Each claimed property has a testable, predeclared pass/fail rule that cannot be replaced by post-hoc aggregate performance.
controls.residuals: Untestable or incompletely specified properties and statistical assumptions remain explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P3/P5 + HB40 6.4.3; inherited. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Preserve independent acceptance data and prevent test-set tuning.
controls.inputs: Acceptance-data baseline; access controls; tuning history; data identifiers/hashes; split rationale.
controls.owner: V&V/QA controls the acceptance baseline; ML has only authorised access.
controls.evidence: Access separation, immutable IDs/hashes, use history, and evidence that acceptance outcomes did not guide tuning.
controls.acceptance criterion: Acceptance data remain independent to the declared degree; any exposure is assessed and the affected evidence is replaced or qualified.
controls.residuals: Prior exposure, repeated benchmarking, hidden dependence, and limited data availability are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P5 + HB40 6.4.3; ECSS test-gate mapping adapted. Status: M when simulation/testing is applicable.
controls.objective: Generate tests and simulations from the ODD and hazard scenarios.
controls.inputs: ODD; hazards; requirements; scenario catalogue; simulator/model credibility; oracle; target environment.
controls.owner: V&V owner with Safety and domain experts.
controls.evidence: Scenario catalogue, coverage rationale, simulator credibility, oracle, procedures, results, and requirement links.
controls.acceptance criterion: Scenarios cover the justified safety-relevant conditions and have credible oracles and environments for the claimed evidence.
controls.residuals: Simulator fidelity, oracle uncertainty, missing scenarios, and extrapolation to operation are documented.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: HB40 6.4.3 formal-method guidance; conditionality/substitution record adapted. Status: C; N.A. when unsuitable.
controls.objective: Use formal methods only for a defined, formalizable property.
controls.inputs: Formal property; model abstraction; assumptions; tool support and confidence; alternative evidence plan.
controls.owner: Formal-method/V&V specialist with Safety and model owner.
controls.evidence: Property, abstraction, assumptions, tool record, proof/result, coverage limit, and alternative evidence.
controls.acceptance criterion: The result is valid for the stated property and assumptions; otherwise N.A. or partial coverage is approved with adequate alternative evidence.
controls.residuals: Abstraction gap, unsupported operators, numerical semantics, scalability, and tool confidence limits are explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: HB40 6.4.3 + applicable security analysis; adapted. Status: C under a credible threat model.
controls.objective: Conduct adversarial testing only against credible threats.
controls.inputs: Threat model; attack surface; adversary capability; perturbation constraints; safety/security consequences.
controls.owner: Security and V&V with Safety.
controls.evidence: Adversarial test design and results, constraint rationale, affected requirements, findings, and residual risk.
controls.acceptance criterion: Tests represent credible attacks and demonstrate compliance or produce controlled findings; demographic fairness is not used as a substitute.
controls.residuals: Unmodelled adversaries, unrealistic perturbations, transferability limits, and unavailable attack access are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P5 + HB40 6.4.3; inherited and operationalized. Status: M when these properties support the safety argument.
controls.objective: Evaluate robustness, edge conditions, OOD behaviour, and uncertainty.
controls.inputs: ODD/reference distribution; boundary and stress scenarios; uncertainty method; requirements; accepted data.
controls.owner: V&V owner with ML, Safety, and domain experts.
controls.evidence: Stratum-level results, stress/boundary tests, OOD definition, uncertainty, anomalies, and stated limits.
controls.acceptance criterion: Results satisfy predeclared requirements by relevant stratum; OOD and uncertainty claims are defined relative to an explicit reference and limitations.
controls.residuals: Unsupported ODD regions, calibration error, rare-event uncertainty, and untested perturbations are retained.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P5 + E40 5.6 + HB40 6.4.3; synthesized. Status: M for intended-use claims.
controls.objective: Validate fitness for intended use by safety-relevant stratum.
controls.inputs: Independent validation data/scenarios; ODD; requirements; uncertainty method; coverage and exposure rationale.
controls.owner: Validation authority independent from model tuning to the required degree.
controls.evidence: Requirement-level pass/fail evidence, results by stratum, confidence/uncertainty, coverage limits, and anomalies.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every intended-use claim passes for the relevant strata or is restricted; aggregate performance cannot mask a failed critical stratum.
controls.links: MV-01 to MV-03; MV-06; SA-02 to SA-03; IV-05.
controls.residuals: Low-support strata, unresolved failures, limited exposure, and domain-shift uncertainty constrain the accepted use.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: E40 5.6/5.8 + HB40 6.4.4; AI implementation scope adapted. Status: M when deployed as software.
controls.objective: Verify and validate the software implementation surrounding the model.
controls.inputs: Pre/post-processing; interfaces; error handling; converter; runtime libraries; configuration; timing/memory and monitoring requirements.
controls.owner: Software V&V authority with Software, CM, and Safety.
controls.evidence: Unit/integration and target tests covering numerical behaviour, interfaces, errors, timing, memory, monitoring, and configuration.
controls.acceptance criterion: The deployed implementation satisfies software requirements and preserves the accepted model behaviour within predeclared tolerances.
controls.residuals: Compiler/library differences, untested error paths, numerical tolerances, and resource margin limits are documented.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: model, software, and system verification and validation.
controls.source/status: E40 integration/acceptance + HB40 6.4.4; synthesized. Status: M for operational acceptance.
controls.objective: Verify and validate the integrated system function and hazard controls.
controls.inputs: System architecture; hazards; hardware/operator/ground interfaces; fallback/safe-mode logic; representative mission scenarios.
controls.owner: System V&V and Safety with acceptance authority participation.
controls.evidence: HIL/system scenarios, interaction and fault-response results, fallback/safe-mode evidence, and mission-context validation.
controls.acceptance criterion: The integrated function and hazard controls satisfy allocated requirements for the intended mission context and accepted authority boundary.
controls.closure authority: System V&V/Safety and project acceptance authority.
controls.residuals: Unmodelled interactions, unavailable HIL fidelity, operator assumptions, and residual system risk are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P6 + HB40 6.4.4 + Q80 CM; synthesized. Status: M when conversion occurs.
controls.objective: Control conversion, quantization, compilation, and target libraries.
controls.inputs: Source-model ID; converter/compiler and library versions/options; target architecture; tool confidence evidence.
controls.owner: Software/ML Engineering with CM and V&V.
controls.evidence: Conversion manifest, target binary ID, tests, numerical-difference analysis, checksums, and tool-confidence record.
controls.acceptance criterion: The target artefact is traceable to the accepted model and any numerical/decision differences remain within predeclared limits.
controls.residuals: Unsupported operators, quantization loss, compiler/library variability, and tool limitations are retained.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: E40 verification/acceptance + HB40 6.4.4; adapted. Status: M when resource or timing constraints exist.
controls.objective: Verify timing, memory, compute, power, and interface budgets on representative target hardware.
controls.inputs: Target platform; budgets; scheduling/interface constraints; representative workload and environment; acceptance limits.
controls.owner: Software/System V&V with platform owner.
controls.evidence: Worst-case or justified representative measurements, margins, environment record, anomalies, and requirement results.
controls.acceptance criterion: Measured or analytically bounded resource use satisfies predeclared limits with approved margin and no unacceptable interference.
controls.residuals: Measurement coverage, environment differences, worst-case assumptions, and remaining margin uncertainty are explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P6 + HB40 6.4.4; tolerance/decision link adapted. Status: M for migrated models.
controls.objective: Demonstrate host-to-target behavioural equivalence or a bounded difference.
controls.inputs: Accepted host model; target binary; paired scenarios; numerical and timing tolerances; safety-decision equivalence rule.
controls.owner: V&V with Software/ML and Safety.
controls.evidence: Paired host/target results, tolerance analysis, safety-decision comparison, unexplained differences, and restrictions.
controls.acceptance criterion: Differences are within predeclared numerical/timing bounds and do not alter accepted safety-relevant decisions, or use is restricted.
controls.residuals: Unexplained mismatch, non-bit-identical execution, platform nondeterminism, and untested scenarios are documented.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: E40 5.7/5.10 + Q80 6.2.4; AI release content adapted. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Make release construction, installation, and rollback reproducible.
controls.inputs: Qualified sources and artefacts; build environment; target configuration; installation procedure; rollback image and authority.
controls.owner: CM and Release Engineering with acceptance authority.
controls.evidence: Release manifest, source-to-binary links, environment, checksums, installation/rollback procedures, image, and approval.
controls.acceptance criterion: The released configuration is uniquely identified, reproducible, installable, and recoverable through an approved rollback path.
controls.residuals: Irreversible updates, supplier dependencies, rollback timing, and unavailable previous images are explicit constraints.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P6 + E40 5.9; monitoring-decision record introduced. Status: C.
controls.objective: Define monitoring according to observability, telemetry, mission constraints, and safety reliance.
controls.inputs: Monitoring objective; observable signals; thresholds; false-alarm/missed-detection trade-off; telemetry; response and retention constraints.
controls.owner: Operations and Safety with Software/System Engineering.
controls.evidence: Monitoring decision, signal/threshold specification, response procedure, retention, validation evidence, and limitations.
controls.acceptance criterion: The selected monitoring supports its stated safety/operational claim and has validated response logic; alternatives or N.A. are justified.
controls.residuals: Unobservable degradation, detection latency, false alarms, telemetry gaps, and ground-contact limits are retained.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: E40 5.10 + AMLAS-P6; ML-specific triggers adapted. Status: M for the policy; implementation is conditional.
controls.objective: Define maintenance, retraining, threshold, data, and platform change controls.
controls.inputs: Update policy; permitted changes; impact-analysis rules; regression/re-review triggers; rollback and obsolescence plan.
controls.owner: CCB with Engineering, CM, V&V, Safety, PA, and Operations.
controls.evidence: Approved change policy identifying authority, triggers, affected evidence, regression depth, re-review, rollback, and end-of-life controls.
controls.acceptance criterion: No change can enter operation without authorised impact assessment and the regression/review required by affected claims and configurations.
controls.gate: AR and CCB; affected gates as triggered.
controls.residuals: Unsupported updates, unavailable retraining data, platform obsolescence, and delayed requalification are documented.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: HB40 6.4.4 + system safety analysis; conditional allocation adapted. Status: C.
controls.objective: Select redundancy, fallback, or a safety cage only where justified by the architecture and hazards.
controls.inputs: Hazards; controllability; safety authority; compensating provisions; observability; latency/resources; transition/failure modes.
controls.owner: System Safety and Architecture owners with V&V.
controls.evidence: Trade-off and design record covering independence, coverage, latency, resources, transitions, failure modes, and tests.
controls.acceptance criterion: The selected provision demonstrably reduces the relevant risk without introducing unacceptable common-cause, transition, or resource hazards.
controls.residuals: Coverage gaps, common-cause risk, unavailable redundancy, unsafe transitions, and fallback limits are retained.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: deployment, operation, fallback, and controlled change.
controls.source/status: E40 5.9 to 5.10 + Q80 finding/CM processes; synthesized. Status: M for observed material anomalies.
controls.objective: Control operational anomalies and reopen affected evidence.
controls.inputs: Anomaly report; affected configuration; telemetry/logs; requirement/claim links; containment and investigation data.
controls.owner: Operations and CCB/project authority with Engineering, V&V, Safety, and PA.
controls.evidence: Anomaly record, containment, root-cause investigation, corrective action, regression, traceability, and release decision.
controls.acceptance criterion: Material anomalies are contained and traced; affected evidence is reopened; corrective or limitation decisions are independently reviewed as required.
controls.gate: Operations review, CCB, and any reopened gate.
controls.residuals: Unknown cause, incomplete telemetry, deferred correction, recurrence risk, and operational restrictions remain explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P1/P2 + E40 requirements + Q80 safety; synthesized. Status: M for safety-relevant use.
controls.objective: Link hazards and system controls to ML, data, software, integration, and monitoring requirements.
controls.inputs: Hazard analysis; system controls; ODD; architecture; allocated ML/software/system requirements; monitoring/fallback concept.
controls.owner: System Safety with Systems Engineering and PA.
controls.evidence: Bidirectional hazard-to-requirement-to-evidence links and allocation rationale.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every safety-relevant hazard/control has complete and configuration-consistent allocations to the evidence chain or an approved rationale.
controls.gate: SRR and PDR; rechecked through AR.
controls.residuals: Unallocated controls, assumptions, weak compensating provisions, and incomplete propagation analysis are explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: AMLAS assurance argument; ECSS gate allocation adapted. Status: M for Category B and any Category A extension; C otherwise by risk.
controls.objective: Construct an explicit claim-context-assumption-strategy-evidence argument.
controls.inputs: Hazards; ODD; requirements; evidence baselines; assumptions; findings; limitations; decision-authority model.
controls.owner: Safety-case owner with PA, V&V, Engineering, and IMVV input.
controls.evidence: Claim/evidence matrix or equivalent argument, contexts, assumptions, defeaters/limitations, findings, and authority record.
controls.acceptance criterion: Each claim is supported by controlled evidence within its stated context; open defeaters and limitations are visible to the decision authority.
controls.residuals: Unsupported claims, invalidated assumptions, evidence gaps, and scope restrictions remain explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: AMLAS risk rationale + Q80 dependability/safety; decision tuple adapted. Status: M when residual safety risk exists.
controls.objective: Record residual uncertainty, limitations, restrictions, and risk acceptance.
controls.inputs: Evidence gaps; anomalies/findings; uncertainty; operational restrictions; compensating provisions; waiver proposals.
controls.owner: Safety/PA prepares; project/customer risk authority decides.
controls.evidence: Residual-risk record linking limitations, restrictions, compensating provisions, waivers, configuration, and sign-off.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every accepted residual risk is traceable, bounded to a configuration/ODD, and signed by the authorised risk owner.
controls.gate: QR and AR; reopened after a material change or anomaly.
controls.links: FR-05 to FR-06; CM-03; DP-05 to DP-08; IV-06.
controls.residuals: Unknown uncertainty, unverified mitigations, conditional acceptance, and waiver expiry remain visible.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: ECSS contractual/tailoring principle; provenance field introduced. Status: M all.
controls.objective: Mark each control as a contractual requirement, source guidance, or Aerosafe recommendation.
controls.inputs: Applicable contractual baseline and tailoring record; cited ECSS/AMLAS clauses; project policies; checklist item.
controls.owner: PA/QA with the process owner.
controls.evidence: Completed source/status field citing the exact project clause or documenting guidance/recommendation and tailoring rationale.
controls.acceptance criterion: No checklist item is presented as normative without an applicable source; every deviation or recommendation has an explicit status and rationale.
controls.links: All items; especially Table 7 and project compliance matrix.
controls.residuals: Ambiguous normativity, superseded clauses, contract-specific interpretations, and unresolved tailoring remain explicit.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: Q80 6.2.6.13 and 6.3.5.28; AI activation factors adapted. Status: C and risk-triggered.
controls.objective: Decide and plan whether independent V&V is activated for the AI-specific evidence scope.
controls.inputs: Criticality and hazard rationale; AI authority; novelty; uncertainty; compensating provisions; contractual needs; assurance plan.
controls.owner: PA/project authority with the proposed IMVV lead.
controls.evidence: ISVV/IMVV activation decision and plan defining scope, roles, inputs, methods, deliverables, interfaces, and finding process.
controls.acceptance criterion: Activation or non-activation is justified by risk and contract; the approved plan is independent, feasible, and traceable to the assurance scope.
controls.links: SC-01; FR-01 to FR-02; SA-01; IV-02 to IV-06.
controls.residuals: Unresolved criticality, limited access, resource constraints, or excluded evidence areas are recorded in the plan.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: Q80 independent-V&V provisions; three-dimension record introduced. Status: M when IMVV is activated.
controls.objective: Record organisational independence.
controls.inputs: Organisation chart; contracts; reporting lines; conflicts; access rights; safeguards against self-approval.
controls.owner: PA/customer authority with IMVV management.
controls.evidence: Independence statement covering reporting, contractual separation, conflicts, access, and escalation routes.
controls.acceptance criterion: IMVV personnel are not accountable for the development decisions they review and have protected access and escalation channels.
controls.residuals: Shared management, funding dependence, unavailable expertise, conflicts, and access restrictions are disclosed and mitigated.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: Q80 independent-V&V provisions + AMLAS evidence challenge; adapted. Status: M when IMVV is activated.
controls.objective: Record technical independence.
controls.inputs: Controlled datasets; scripts/tools; model/software/target artefacts; reproduction plan; sampling strategy; tool access.
controls.owner: IMVV lead with independent CM/QA support.
controls.evidence: Independent baseline, tools/scripts or justified alternatives, reproduction/sampling record, and limits to independence.
controls.acceptance criterion: The independent team can reproduce or challenge the scoped evidence from controlled inputs without relying solely on developer interpretation.
controls.links: CM-01 to CM-02; MV-02; DP-01 to DP-03; IV-05.
controls.residuals: Unavailable proprietary tools/data, shared scripts, sampling limits, and unreproduced results are recorded.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: Q80 finding/independent-review intent; explicit separation introduced. Status: M when IMVV is activated.
controls.objective: Record decisional independence and formal closure authority.
controls.inputs: RACI/authority matrix; review plan; finding process; waiver and risk-acceptance rules.
controls.owner: PA/project authority.
controls.evidence: Authority matrix distinguishing evidence owner, reviewer, finding owner, disposition proposer, waiver authority, and formal closer.
controls.acceptance criterion: No evidence owner can unilaterally close the independent finding or accept its residual risk; escalation and waiver paths are named.
controls.residuals: Role overlap, delegated authority, absent customer participation, and emergency dispositions are explicitly controlled.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: AMLAS-P1 to P6 + Q80 independent V&V; AI evidence scope introduced/adapted. Status: C according to the IV-01 scope.
controls.objective: Independently challenge the AI-specific evidence chain.
controls.inputs: Scoped requirements; ODD; data/labels; model/pipeline; converters; target evidence; interfaces; monitoring; claims and traceability.
controls.owner: IMVV team; developers provide artefacts and responses.
controls.evidence: Independent reviews, reproductions, samples, challenge records, findings, affected configurations/claims, and recommendation.
controls.acceptance criterion: The approved IMVV scope is covered; departures and unsupported claims are raised as traceable findings rather than silently accepted.
controls.gate: QR and AR, with earlier reviews as planned.
controls.residuals: Excluded artefacts, limited samples, unreproduced evidence, unresolved findings, and scope constraints remain visible.

controls.checklist_group_title: Operational checklist: safety argument, normative status, and IMVV.
controls.source/status: Q80 independent-V&V report/finding provisions; AI claim linkage adapted. Status: M for every raised finding.
controls.objective: Manage IMVV findings to auditable closure.
controls.inputs: Finding log; severity; affected configuration/claims; owner; corrective action; retest/review; waiver and closure records.
controls.owner: PA controls the process; action owners respond; IMVV verifies; designated authority closes.
controls.evidence: Finding record, corrective evidence, independent retest/review, disposition, waiver or closure signature, and traceability update.
controls.acceptance criterion: Every finding has complete provenance and an authorised disposition; a gate cannot close contrary to the applicable project rules.
controls.links: TR-01; FR-05 to FR-06; SA-02 to SA-03; CM-03; DP-08.
controls.residuals: Open findings, conditional waivers, incomplete retest, recurring defects, and accepted limitations remain linked to release acceptance.
